config.voxyworldgenv2.title: Voxy World Gen V2 Config
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.enabled.too: Completely enable or disable the mod's generation logic.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.f3_stats.to: Show generation statistics in the F3 debug menu.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.radius.tool: The radius (in chunks) around players to generate.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.update_inte: How often to scan for new ungenerated chunks.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.max_queue.t: Maximum number of chunks to keep in the pending queue.
Maximum number of chunks generating simultaneously.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.throttle_en: Slow down or pause generation when memory runs low or the game lags.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.throttle_ms: Generation slows down while server ticks take longer than this. A tick has 50 ms at 20 TPS.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.throttle_fp: Singleplayer and LAN host only: generation slows down while the focused game runs below this frame rate. 0 turns it off.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.throttle_sl: Generation slows down when the memory still in use after the last garbage collection passes this share of the maximum heap.
config.voxyworldgenv2.option.throttle_pa: Generation pauses above this share of the maximum heap and resumes below it.
